name: @onegrid/prisma
description: Prisma adapter for oneGrid SSRM. Compiles BlockRequest into Prisma Client argument objects — where / orderBy / cursor+take+skip keyset pagination / select — pushes grouping down to groupBy with _sum/_avg/_min/_max/_count, introspects DMMF into a oneGrid Schema, and bridges live changes into @onegrid/orm-sync.
